items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: And she made a lot of money but she was for dignity. She ever hired Eddie South to come down to St. Louis to play at lunchtime. These girls after streaking the hair, at lunchtime they had to come in this little theater and sit down and listen to some nice music like Eddie South would play because see this was the kind of lady. Another lady was Madame Walker.
Yeah, I was about to say Madame Walker.
